name: lanier
description: Socratic learning companion for interactive multimedia design, grounded in the work of Carlos Alberto Peláez Ayala.

interface.longDescription: Lanier supports students in reasoning about interactive multimedia systems through questions, evidence and reflection. Includes the original Spanish instructions and nine reference works covering preproduction, value creation, stakeholders, responsible design, feasibility and user stories. Spanish is the default language.
defaultPrompt: Acompáñame a examinar mi propuesta de sistema multimedia.
Ayúdame a cuestionar mi identificación de interesados directos e indirectos.
Quiero revisar la justificación de una historia de usuario.

publication.release_notes: Corrects the directory category to Education & Research. Includes the public Lanier website, support, privacy policy and terms URLs. Tutoring instructions and knowledge documents are unchanged.

es-419.subtitle: Diseño multimedia socrático
es-419.description: Lanier acompaña a estudiantes mediante preguntas, reflexión y argumentación sobre sus decisiones de diseño de sistemas interactivos y multimedia. Incluye nueve obras de referencia aportadas por Carlos Alberto Peláez Ayala.

review.commerce_description: Lanier is currently provided without charges by its publisher. It does not sell products, offer paid subscriptions or process payments.
